coverImageAlt: A navy reel pulls a tangled bundle of slate cord into three orderly cyan thread spools with sparing orange strands.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A dense tangle of vulnerable orange and slate threads being wound through one disciplined red-team reel into orderly risk spools, expressing adversarial business-idea analysis that turns hidden failure paths into an actionable damage report.
Scene/backdrop: Uncluttered warm-paper repair bench set against deep slate, with a single clear before-and-after path.
Subject: One dominant navy winding reel; thorny tangled threads and a few cracked clay fragments enter from one side, then emerge as three clean cyan-bound spools arranged by severity, all without labels or symbols.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; linen cord, machined reel, ceramic fragments, paper-wrapped spools, and restrained handcrafted realism.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; strong diagonal transformation around the central reel; tangle and ordered spools remain bold at approximately 290-pixel card width; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: probing but controlled, calm and capable rather than alarming; restrained cyan edge light and sparing orange only in the vulnerable threads.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: coarse linen thread, matte metal, torn paper fibers, chalky ceramic, subtle workshop patina.
Constraints: original image; one dominant untangling metaphor; no hazard icons or written labels; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: gore, weapons, flames, warning symbols, red alert dashboards, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, visual chaos beyond the controlled thread tangle, Microsoft-like gradients.
Targeted correction: Pull the camera back and reduce the tangle so the complete before-and-after transformation, every loose thread end, the full reel, and all three spools fit inside the inner 84% with a dark border; make the tangle predominantly slate with only two or three sparing orange strands, and keep the scene clean enough to read at card size.
